Bacon command line:
Bacon ("LkDove", thick=10, acc.mean=c(80,20), hiatus.depths = 125, hiatus.mean = 2, d.max=500, depths.file = TRUE)

0 #d.min
500 #d.max
1 #d.by
1 #depths.file
NA #slump
80 20 #acc.mean
1.5 1.5 #acc.shape
0.7 #mem.mean
4 #mem.strength
125 #hiatus.depths
2 #hiatus.mean
1 #hiatus.shape
0 #BCAD
1 #cc
0 #postbomb
IntCal13 #cc1
Marine13 #cc2
SHCal13 #cc3
ConstCal #cc4
cm #unit
0 #normal
3 #t.a
4 #t.b
0 #d.R
0 #d.STD

site.sitedescription: Lake Dove lies at the northern end of the Cradle Mountain-Lake St. Clair National Park in northwestern Tasmania.
